stem: In a comparison of two checkout designs, design B converts better than design A on desktop and on mobile, but worse overall. An analyst concludes the totals must contain a calculation error. What is the most likely explanation instead?

options.text: Most of B's traffic comes from the device that converts less
The totals are wrong, since a winner on every device wins overall
The test ran too briefly for the device results to be reliable
Desktop users bought dearer products than mobile users
